MAKE IT PERSONAL

Your nutrition blueprint

A starting estimate for adults. Adjust as your weight, energy and training change.

Starting estimates: muscle +5%; fat loss −15%; strength/maintenance unchanged. Protein 1.8–2 g/kg; fat 25%; remaining energy from carbs.
Why these targets? Strength, muscle and dietary fat

Protein: about 1.4–2.0 g/kg for exercising adults. Strength does not always require a surplus. Carbs depend on training volume.

Dietary fat supports essential functions. We use 25% of calories. Body-fat percentage is not required.

ISSN protein position stand · Energy-surplus study · Sports nutrition review
